template: Hello! Thank you for taking the time to speak with us today. To get started, could you briefly introduce yourself and share a bit about your current professional situation?
What sparked your interest in the {role} position here at our company?
Can you confirm your highest level of education and your field of study?
How many total years of professional experience do you have in the tech industry, specifically working as a {role}?
Could you walk me through your most recent project involving {key_technology}? What was your specific contribution?
intent: Qualitative assessment of recent relevant technical experience.

template: Have you ever led a team or mentored junior team members?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your proficiency in {primary_skill}?
Do you have working experience with {secondary_skill} in a production environment?
intent: Verify secondary or optional tech stack skills.

template: Are you currently located in {job_location}, or are you open to relocating there for this role?
intent: Confirm geographic eligibility or relocation willingness.

template: This role operates in a {work_model} model. Are you comfortable with this working arrangement?
What are your expected compensation requirements for this role?
Are you open to a flexible compensation structure, including performance bonuses or equity options?
intent: Understand flexibility on total compensation package.

template: What is your current notice period or availability to join?
If offered the position, would you be able to start by {target_start_date}?
intent: Check alignment with tight hiring timelines.
